evidence_status: Public-source building facts plus inferred plan topology and explicitly assumed fit-out, structure sizes and MEP routes. Not an as-built, construction or engineering approval model.

lifts.evidence: R02 states 16 office passenger lifts; R03 plans suggest three bank sectors; R04 shows transfers at 21/22. Exact bank allocation/stops and two upper shuttle proxies are assumptions. R06 historic total 18 remains an unresolved scope conflict.

exclusions: No survey, coordinated construction drawings, exact core dimensions or current tenant fit-out are available; plan-derived locations are approximate.
The original demo remains unchanged. This preset combines dated public sources, not one verified historical or current state.
Lift bank allocation, travel limits and two upper shuttle proxies are inferred; 16-office-lift and 18-passenger-lift public totals have unresolved scope differences.
Model level indices and exceptional lobby/top floor heights are approximate; published transfer-level labels are stored as evidence, not surveyed stop coordinates.
No structural loads, member design, connections, foundations or lateral analysis; radial beam and column sections are proxies.
No fire strategy, egress-capacity, sprinkler coverage/hydraulics, accessibility or code-compliance assessment.
Wet risers and basin branches are conceptual. Drainage branches, pressure zoning, insulation, valves and rated penetrations are not designed.
Four-pipe fan coils are equipment proxies with labelled connection stubs; complete HVAC ductwork and hydronic distribution are not designed.
Electrical routes are geometric networks only: voltage, conductor ratings, loads, protection, fault levels, earthing, selectivity, emergency supply and lux are unverified.
DALI link/address groups are illustrative; device commissioning and protocol capacity/compliance are not verified.
Pipe-system clearance, protected-shaft routing and terminal connectivity checks are limited checks, not an exhaustive clash or engineering coordination review.
Basement, accommodation stairs at published levels 19-25, complete entrance/retail fit-out and exact rooftop restaurant layout remain omitted.

structure.evidence: R01 supports steel core, radial beams on 10-degree centres and perimeter hoops. Core bearing radius, member sections/positions, dome lattice sampling and omitted collisions are inferred.

electrical.evidence: R04 dual power supply; R05 DALI, LON/BMS integration and occupancy/daylight multisensors. All board positions, feed assignment, outlets, circuit grouping, cable/tray dimensions and routes are inferred. No electrical ratings are selected.
